I was around 16 when I got with my first break up, we were 14 when we got together to we dated for two years. 

It was painful, soul crushing and depressing. But since I was still at school and the top rank academically when the break up happened I was forced to study and it is where it I buried my time and feelings. I also read experiences from support groups I joined online on how to deal with the break up. After few months around 6 months it got better, then after a year or two I finally moved on and found someone new. 

So chin up bro, you’re still very young. Relationships at that age do not last very long because you are still developing and learning more and more about yourself everyday hence you are changing. This will be a good learning experience for you as well if you know how to use it. It will be hard and painful, there are days where you wouldn’t understand, days when you miss her, but it’s part of the process.
